jobs.description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

We're hiring a Project Manager - Distribution & Automation Engineering to join our Global Supply Chain team at Cencora.

Responsibilities

Works closely with project director or operations director to assist in the development of a project charter and manages components of the project design and implementation plans according to the guidelines established in the project charter.
Manages and reports on project budgets and time lines according to project assignments made by either the project director or the operations director.
Supports in the development of supplier specifications, supports the contractual negotiations and manages the execution of the plans outlined in the contracts.
Manages engagement with external consultants and other outsourced resources that perform work associated with items such as material handling equipment, warehouse and business systems, building modifications and other various services.
Coordinates activities with project director or operations director and other internal project teams to ensure alignment.
Assists in the preparation of capital expenditure requests for projects.
Responsible for project completion according to assignments including but not limited to construction/installation, inspection, testing, training, and start up.
Willing to travel up to 75% of the time.

Experience And Educational Requirements

Requires training and experience in fields such as business administration, engineering, accountancy, sales, marketing, logistics, computer sciences or similar vocations generally obtained through completion of a four year bachelor's degree program or equivalent combination of experience and education.
Normally requires a minimum of five (5) years directly related and progressively responsible experience.

Skills And Knowledge Requirements

Demonstrated knowledge, understanding and experience leading projects related to warehouse operations, warehouse design, warehouse and business systems, process improvement and standardization, engineered labor standards, and transportation.
Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing; ability to communicate (and work) effectively with people from different technical and business backgrounds, acting as a liaison, understanding and appreciating different perspectives and translating into terms necessary for any group or individual to understand.
Ability to lead dynamically and energize work teams to learn and apply new skills and techniques to respond to business needs
Good analytical, conceptual and problem solving skills to evaluate business problems and apply knowledge to identify appropriate solutions
Strong interpersonal skills
Understands how to communicate difficult/sensitive information tactfully.
Strong presentation skills; ability to present and discuss strategies and technical information in a manner that establishes rapport, persuades others, and establishes understanding for technical and non-technical audiences
Strong organizational skills; attention to detail
Ability to resolve issues effectively and efficiently
Proficiency with project management tools such as Microsoft Project, Excel, Access databases, Word and AutoCad
Prior experience in either consulting, Six-Sigma, Lean Manufacturing or Kaizen is beneficial.

jobs.title: Marketing Project Delivery Manager
jobs.description:
Brief Description

As a Marketing Project Delivery Manager at Tricel, you will play a pivotal role in managing and delivering a diverse portfolio of marketing projects, with a particular focus on the connection between marketing and development processes. You will ensure that all marketing initiatives are delivered efficiently, on time, and within budget, while demonstrating a strong understanding of development methodologies and technologies. The successful candidate will demonstrate strong marketing channel expertise, CRM knowledge, and project management skills to deliver best-in-class marketing programmes across the full marketing mix. You will be experienced in online conversion and will actively run optimisation initiatives to ensure benchmark-level performance across all channels. You will act as the owner of all digital project execution related to design and development, continuously improving processes to ensure delivery takes place in a lean and optimised environment. The Project Manager will be responsible for leading a team that supports the department with the setup, installation, and management of marketing technology tools and products. They will work with stakeholders and end users to plan and configure systems, developing solutions that achieve the required objectives. They will oversee the deployment of programmes and systems, coordinating all parties involved to ensure a smooth process with minimal disruption. The successful candidate must be comfortable working in an agency-style environment where resources need to be managed effectively. The Marketing Project Delivery Manager will report directly to the Group Head of Marketing.

Responsibilities

Manage the day-to-day workload of the design and development team, covering activities from minor updates to Tier 1 project rollouts.
Manage the end-to-end delivery of digital projects and associated technology infrastructure, including marketing automation and CRM integration.
Work closely with technical teams to understand development constraints and opportunities, ensuring marketing initiatives are technically feasible.
Take ownership of both your own platforms and the wider digital platform, safeguarding their reputation within the business and across customer groups.
Act as the primary point of contact for counterpart marketing executives, leading future initiative pipeline readiness, resource planning, capacity estimation, and associated budgeting.
Manage dependencies and interfaces between projects, channels, and platforms, as well as risks and issues that may affect team success, ensuring resources are used appropriately, stakeholders are kept informed, and the consequences of actions are clearly understood.
Provide comprehensive reports on project performance, timelines, and budget.
Analyse project outcomes and identify opportunities for improvement in future projects.
Manage marketing standard operating procedures, including creating new SOPs, maintaining and updating existing procedures, and ensuring the marketing team remains aligned with approved SOPs.
Onboard new Tricel Group team members to the CRM and wider marketing technology stack, ensuring they understand the relevant tools, processes, and best-practice ways of working.
Lead cross-disciplinary programmes aimed at improving conversion across all channels used in the marketing mix, with particular emphasis on websites and other digital media.
Lead daily team stand-ups, track risks, and help eliminate blockers.
Build and maintain a motivated delivery team, including third-party development resources, ensuring there is an iterative plan to work towards.
Drive the digital team to work at pace, ensuring the team remains focused on delivery commitments.
Ensure the team collaborates effectively, communicates clearly, and focuses on the highest-priority work.
Coach team members and colleagues, facilitate continuous improvement, and apply the most appropriate agile and lean tools and techniques for the environment.

Candidate Profile

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Computer Science, or a related field.
3 - 5 years’ experience in project management, with a strong understanding of both marketing and development processes.
Strong leadership and team management skills.
Excellent organisational and time-management abilities.
Proficient in project management tools and software; JIRA experience is preferred but not mandatory.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously in an agency-style setup.
Ability to identify opportunities to deliver an excellent customer experience through project delivery.
Knowledge of computer operating systems, hardware, and software.
Strong analytical thinking skills.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent qualification.
Experience in digital marketing or creative project management.
Familiarity with the latest marketing trends and technologies.
Expertise in CRM management; HubSpot experience is preferred but not mandatory.
Experience working in a cross-functional role involving marketing and software development.
Technical understanding of web development concepts.

What do we offer?

At Tricel, we care about your development and progression. Alongside a competitive salary and benefits package, we offer:

Excellent development and growth opportunities
A supportive and collaborative culture
A fun and dynamic work environment
Team-oriented atmosphere.
Good work-life balance.
Opportunity to work across countries and cultures
Employee Assistance Programme
Tax-free vouchers to the value of €1,500
Sports and Social Club.
Health and Wellbeing initiatives
Enhanced maternity leave.
Health Insurance Contribution

About Tricel

Tricel, a family-run business, was founded in 1973 by Anne Stack and Con Stack. The company began by producing products from glass-reinforced plastics (GRP) and expanded its exports and manufacturing facilities across the UK and Europe through a comprehensive growth strategy in the 1990s and 2000s. The Stack family continues to lead Tricel, which provides market-leading solutions in more than 50 countries. The company serves markets including storage tanks, pumps, sewage treatment tanks, construction products, and lubricant distribution. Headquartered in Killarney, the Tricel Group consists of 19 companies across Europe, including seven manufacturing facilities, and employs more than 600 people across these locations. The company has grown domestically and internationally by manufacturing locally, exporting, partnering with local distributors, and acquiring companies that strengthen its product capabilities and geographical reach. Over the next five years, the company’s roadmap for growth will continue to be based on three main pillars: Customer Excellence, Innovation, and Sustainability.

How To Apply

If you are interested in applying for this exciting opportunity, please email HR@tricel.ie with your CV and cover letter. We look forward to hearing from you. Closing date for applications is 5pm, Monday 24th August 2026.

Tricel is an equal opportunities employer.

We are seeking an experienced Switches Project manager to join our engineering team at an OEM company. The successful candidate will be responsible for the design, development, and validation of interior switch components for automotive applications. This role involves working with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, reliable, and innovative switch solutions that meet customer and regulatory requirements.

The ideal candidate will have prior experience in the automotive sector, specifically with OEM or Tier 1 suppliers, and be well-versed in key product development activities such as DVP (Design Validation Plan) and DFMEA (Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis).

Key Responsibilities

Support Technical expert in the design, development, and validation of interior switch systems, ensuring they meet functional, quality, and safety standards for automotive applications.

The switches include following but not limited to stalk control, start-stop switch, DNR switches etc.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams including design, electrical, software, and quality departments to develop innovative switch technologies.

Work & manage the design and development of switches into vehicle platforms, from concept to production, ensuring all technical requirements are met.

Prepare and execute DVP (Design Validation Plan) and support testing phases to ensure switches meet rigorous performance criteria.

Conduct DFMEA (Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) to identify and mitigate potential risks and failures in the design phase.

Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers and ensure adherence to best practices and industry standards.

Collaborate with suppliers and vendors to ensure timely delivery of components and resolve any technical issues that may arise.

Contribute to product design reviews and ensure compliance with relevant automotive standards and regulations.

Track and report on project progress, ensuring timely delivery of design milestones and final product release.

Actively participate in the development of cost-reduction initiatives and improvements in the product lifecycle.

Required Skills

Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Automotive Engineering (or related field).

Minimum 5+ years of experience in automotive switch system design, with a focus on interior switch components.

Proven experience working with OEM or Tier 1 automotive suppliers.

Strong knowledge of automotive engineering processes, including DVP and DFMEA methodologies.

Hands-on experience with switch design, testing, and validation processes.

Familiarity with CAD tools (e.g., CATIA, Siemens NX, SolidWorks) and design verification tools.

Strong understanding of automotive electrical and mechanical systems.

Experience in working within cross-functional teams and managing technical projects from concept to production.

Excellent problem-solving skills with a strong ability to identify, analyze, and resolve design challenges.

Preferred Skills

Experience with automotive interior switch design for specific vehicle types (e.g., luxury, electric vehicles).

Familiarity with the latest automotive trends, including HMI (Human-Machine Interface) and touch-based switch technologies.

Advanced knowledge of material selection and process engineering for automotive components.

Knowledge of regulatory requirements such as ISO 26262 (functional safety), ECE regulations, and other automotive standards.

Experience with supplier management and working within a global supply chain.

jobs.description:
Are you ready to trade your job for a journey? Become a FlyMate!

Passion, excitement & global collaboration are all core to what it means to be a FlyMate. At Flywire, we’re on a mission to deliver the world’s most important and complex payments. We use our Flywire Advantage - the combination of our next-gen payments platform, proprietary payment network and vertical specific software, to help our clients get paid, and help their customers pay with ease - no matter where they are in the world.

What more do we need to truly be unstoppable? Perhaps, that is you!

Who we are:

Flywire is a global payments enablement and software company, founded more than a decade ago to solve high-stakes, high-value payments in higher education. We’ve since scaled into new regions and industry verticals and expanded our product offerings to deliver meaningful value to our clients around the world.

Today we support more than 5,300 clients across the global education, healthcare, travel & B2B industries, with diverse payment methods across 240 countries & territories and more than 140 currencies.

With over 1,200 global FlyMates, representing more than 40 nationalities, and in 12 offices world-wide, we’re looking for FlyMates to join the next stage of our journey as we continue to grow.

Job Description

The Opportunity

Flywire is building an AI-native commercial organization where automation, agents, and connected systems power how marketing operates. This role sits at the center of that shift. You will own how we identify and eliminate manual work across marketing, and replace it with scalable, intelligent systems that improve speed, output, and business impact. This is a builder role with high autonomy and visibility, focused on turning fragmented workflows into structured, AI-driven infrastructure that directly supports pipeline and revenue.

Identify manual, repetitive workflows across marketing and replace them with AI-driven solutions
Build and deploy agentic workflows across content, segmentation, reporting, and lead enrichment
Design connected systems and data pipelines that surface insights automatically
Create a centralized, AI-queryable knowledge foundation across product, personas, and market intelligence
Automate campaign reporting, post-event analysis, and ongoing performance insights
Partner cross-functionally to connect data, systems, and workflows across Product, Sales, RevOps, and Marketing
Build the technical foundation that improves Flywire’s discoverability in AI-driven search environments

Qualifications

Here's what we're looking for:

4 to 8 years of experience in marketing, marketing technology, growth, or RevOps, with enough context to connect what you build to pipeline and revenue outcomes
Proven ability to take a manual or broken workflow and build a working AI-driven solution independently
Strong AI fluency, with hands-on experience building workflows and automations using tools like Claude Code, Cursor, n8n, Make, Gumloop, or similar
Technical aptitude and comfort working with systems, APIs, webhooks, and data flows
Direct experience using AI tools to meaningfully automate or accelerate your work, beyond basic content generation
Ability to operate cross-functionally and earn access to the data and systems your work depends on
Clear point of view on where AI in marketing is heading, grounded in real use rather than theory
Builder mindset, demonstrated through side projects, experiments, or internal tools
Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, high-autonomy environment

Additional Information

Competitive compensation
Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
Flying Start - Our immersive Global Induction Program (Meet our Execs & Global Teams)
Work with brilliant people that will keep you on your toes, learn more about their journeys by checking out #InsideFlywire on social media
Dynamic & Global Team (we have been collaborating virtually for years!)
Wellbeing Programs (Mental Health, Wellness, Yoga/Pilates/HIIT Classes) with Global FlyMates
Competitive time off including FlyBetter Days to volunteer in your community and Digital Disconnect Days!
Great Talent & Development Programs (Managers Taking Flight – for new or aspiring managers!)

Submit today and get started!

We are excited to get to know you! Throughout our process you can expect to meet different FlyMates including the Hiring Manager and other Flymates. Your Talent Acquisition Partner will walk you through the steps and be your “go-to” person for questions.

jobs.description:
Description

General program information and/or position overview:

Leidos’ Undersea Systems Division is seeking a Project Manager in San Diego, CA to join a fast-paced R&D engineering group. This role is a unique opportunity to drive innovation in underwater vehicle systems, maritime sensors, subsea telemetry, and ISR solutions that support critical defense and national security missions at Naval Information Warfare Center, Pacific (NIWC PAC).

Leidos’ USD is a recognized leader in C4ISR technologies, delivering innovative, mission-critical solutions across sensor networks, unmanned systems, and tactical platforms. We’re known for achieving “industry firsts” in the most challenging maritime domains.

The selected candidate will be part of an elite, top-notch group and will be responsible for overseeing and managing the acceptance, testing, and certification of unmanned maritime vehicles for a rapid-paced, high-priority project. This is a high-impact leadership role that bridges the gap between the vehicle R&D team and the onsite production team. The Vehicle Production Lead manages the laboratory/shop environment, directs a team of technicians, and ensures that each unmanned platform meets the government’s rigorous testing requirements and system specifications.

Join us and be part of a world-class team delivering unmatched solutions for today's most pressing maritime missions.

This position will require the candidate to maintain a Top Secret Clearance.

This position will require the candidate to work a 9/80B schedule (80 hours of work into nine days over a two-week period, allowing for every other Friday off) to align with the NIWC government team.

Primary Responsibilities

Coordinate with NIWC Vehicle SMEs to review vehicle system data and address unforeseen technical issues.
Support the Test Director with planning and executing at-sea Factory Acceptance Tests (FATs), performance testing, and certification checks.
Manage and maintain the Master Production Schedule (MPS) along with system software and hardware baseline milestones.
Engage with industry partners on schedules, issues, and resources that impact NIWC’s ability to deliver fully tested and operational vehicles on schedule.
Keep NIWC project leadership (PM, DPM, LSE, and Vehicle Lab Lead) informed of risks, issues, and challenges.
Oversee the configuration of vehicles to support sponsor requirements.
Generate vehicle readiness reports and track the status of each vehicle’s issues/failures.
Manage vehicle inventory, materials, parts, and procurement of lab supplies.
Align the flow of materials to meet production requirements.
Prepare procurement requests for the production or purchase of components or parts based on the Master Production Schedule, shop load, and inventory requirements.
Manage vehicle production lab space and test equipment.
Manage local test procedures, tools, and equipment for conducting vehicle preparation, checkout, and post data offload for each system and at-sea event.
Coordinate with industry partners to develop in-lab test procedures, plans, tools, and equipment to ensure proper Factory and Government Acceptance Testing.
Liaison between Engineering/R&D and Production teams.
Implement, manage, and oversee quality assurance and configuration management programs for the vehicle production effort.
Maintain current knowledge of the quality control field, relying on current literature pertaining to materials use, technological advances, or statistical studies.
Analyze data to inform operational decisions or activities.
Affect significant improvements in projects, processes, and solutions to enhance results.

Basic Qualifications

U.S. Citizen with ability to obtain TOP SECRET security clearance; active SECRET clearance required.
Bachelor’s (or higher) degree from an accredited institution and 5+ years of relevant experience.
Process-oriented and attention to detail.Strong leadership skills.
Experience working with and managing small groups.
Must be flexible and responsive to customer needs.
Requires frequent movement around piers, docks, and facility spaces.
Required to transport or lift objects weighing up to 50 pounds across the facility.
Requires constant use of hands/fingers to operate machinery, tools, or computer equipment.
Requires ability to move about the warehouse, stoop, kneel, or reach for extended periods.
Ability to climb ladders up to 20 feet.
Able and willing to work aboard marine vessels of various sizes, sometimes overnight.
Requires work in various temperatures and inclement weather.
Required to work in /or in loud production environments.
Supervise 1+ personnel in their daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly activities and provide mentoring, guidance, and career discussions for direct report employee(s).
Be responsible for hiring, firing, raises, promotions, and all HR associated actions for direct report employee(s).

Preferred Qualifications, Skills, And Experience

System production experience
Excellent written and oral communication skills and teamwork abilities.
Highly organized and able to prioritize tasks for team members.
Ability to read, understand, and interpret complex technical documents.
Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills
UUV testing experience (or general at-sea test experience)
Project management experience
Experience with Microsoft Office and Visio
Experience with Open Project is a plus
Ability to operate crane/davit
Capable of supporting at-sea testing is a plus
Small boat certified (or willingness to get certified) is a plus

jobs.description:
Schellman is a Top 50 CPA firm and a leading provider of attestation and compliance services. Our professional services focus on security and privacy audits, assessments, and certifications. Schellman has become one of the largest cybersecurity assessment firms in the United States without providing any traditional accounting services. We are an accredited multi-framework ISO Certification Body for security, privacy, business continuity, and quality; a globally licensed PCI Qualified Security Assessor and a top provider to clients serving the federal DoD space as a leading FedRAMP 3PAO and the first assessment firm authorized as a CMMC C3PAO. Our specialty and expertise remain in providing best in class Cybersecurity and IT Audits and Attestations. Our culture, approach with clients, and dedication to our values has led us to consistently be a Great Places to Work certified company and rated as a Best Firms to Work For by Accounting Today and a Glassdoor Best Places to Work. We deeply appreciate our employees, as shown by our first core value – People Come First. This is demonstrated in our culture, benefits, and how we handle business. Come see what makes Schellman special!

Job Summary

The Program Manager is responsible for independently owning a portfolio of multiple, interconnected workstreams and ensuring they collectively deliver strategic value to the organization. This role manages interdependencies, risks, and resources across those workstreams, aligning outcomes with business objectives, and serves as the primary point of accountability for program-level status and decision-making. The Program Manager also owns change management planning and execution for assigned initiatives — assessing change impact, building the change management plan, and partnering with stakeholders across the firm to drive adoption. The Program Manager collaborates with stakeholders — including senior and executive leadership — to ensure transparency, governance, and successful execution of initiatives, and provides mentorship to Project Managers and Project Coordinators to help build project management capability across the PMO. This role does not have formal management authority over other Project Managers' workstreams but is expected to guide and mentor less senior team members informally. The Program Manager reports to the Manager of Enterprise PMO.

Essential Functions

Program Management:

Independently own and lead multiple interconnected workstreams or projects that roll up into a broader program, from initiation through close
Manage interdependencies, risks, issues, and resource allocation across those workstreams
Facilitate stakeholder engagement and communication across business units, including regular exposure to senior and executive leadership
Monitor program performance and ensure alignment with scope, schedule, and budget across all workstreams
Provide regular reporting and insights to PMO leadership and executives on program-level status, risks, and outcomes
Serve as an informal mentor to Project Managers and Project Coordinators, sharing PMO methodology, tools, and best practices
Ensure compliance with PMO standards and contribute to methodology and process improvements
Champion the advancement of the PMO by bringing forward best practices in project and program management from across the industry
Develop and maintain dashboards and reporting that give leadership clear, timely visibility into program and portfolio health
Serve as a subject matter expert in program management tools and platforms, driving effective adoption and use across the PMO

Change Management

Assess the change management needs of each assigned initiative based on audience (directly and indirectly impacted) and the size, scope, and complexity of the planned change
Create a comprehensive change management plan (CMP), consistent with and aligned to the broader Schellman strategy, to include:
Communications needs and activities
Training needs
Ongoing support and documentation needs
Timeline, budget, and measurable success criteria

Partner with stakeholders and functional resources across the firm to execute the change management plan and drive adoption

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Strong program and portfolio management skills, with demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent, interdependent workstreams
Ability to manage complexity and cross-functional coordination without direct authority over contributing team members
Demonstrated ability to build and execute change management plans, including communications, training, and adoption measurement
Ability to partner cross-functionally across the firm to drive adoption of change initiatives
Skilled in building dashboards and reporting, with strong working expertise in program/project management tools and platforms
Experience managing IT-related projects and demonstrated ability to select and blend project management approaches (waterfall, agile, hybrid) based on workstream needs
Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement abilities, including comfort presenting to senior and executive leadership
Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop less experienced project management staff
Proficiency in Excel, Word, Wrike and JIRA or other project management software

Education, Work Experience And Certifications

Bachelor's degree in Business, IT, or a related field, or equivalent years of directly related experience
7+ years of project/program management experience, including demonstrated experience managing multiple interconnected or large-scale initiatives concurrently
Experience building and leading change management plans (communications, training, adoption) for enterprise initiatives
Experience mentoring or informally guiding other project management staff
Experience working on IT-related projects, applying both waterfall and agile/hybrid delivery approaches
PMP or PgMP certification preferred

Schellman is an equal opportunity employer (EOE) and strongly supports diversity in the workplace; therefore, providing equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected basis, including arrest and conviction records, in accordance with applicable law. Schellman uses E-Verify in our hiring process.

At Schellman, we strive to provide a flexible and balanced environment and therefore offer the opportunity to work remotely, unless otherwise stated in the job requirements. Connecting, collaborating and continuous education are also highly valued and therefore we require some travel annually for our Internal Service Delivery roles, which can include in-person training, team meet-ups, and strategy meetings. Service Delivery team members will also be required to travel based on business and client needs.

Reporting To: Manager, Project Management, Americas

Location: Peachtree Corners, GA (Hybrid)

What You’ll Do

Lead customer workshops to achieve project goals, working cross-functionally to develop holistic solutions and establish best practices using AlgoSec technologies.
Orchestrate and synchronize multiple workstreams across different functions within AlgoSec, ensuring alignment and effective execution of strategic initiatives, both internally and with external stakeholders.
Build trusted, strategic advisor relationships with customers, accelerating solution adoption, supporting successful production deployment, and helping customers realize sustained business value from AlgoSec.
Provide clear, effective communication to customer stakeholders and executives throughout the engagement lifecycle.
Lead and manage collaboration between customers, partners, and internal project teams to foster strong relationships and drive successful project outcomes.
Manage multiple related customer projects across the full engagement lifecycle, from planning through production, ensuring the overall program supports strategic objectives and is delivered on time, within scope, and within budget.
Serve as the voice of the customer across AlgoSec, addressing needs and issues while supporting retention, customer satisfaction, and team efficiency.
Support pre-sales activities by partnering with Account Managers, developing Statements of Work and Jump Start Packages, and engaging and managing subcontractors in accordance with established terms and conditions.

What We’re Looking For

5+ years of Program Management experience or related, proven success of increasing customer satisfaction, adoption, and retention. Experience with outbound customers is a must, along with 2+ years of working with Director-level leaders and above.
Experience working in large technology or enterprise environments. A background in IT or cybersecurity, particularly firewall administration and configuration, is preferred.
Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with a proactive approach to building relationships and solving problems.
Adaptable and results-oriented, with the ability to learn quickly, work independently, overcome obstacles, remain effective under pressure, and manage shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Strong understanding of change management principles, processes, and best practices.

Strong consultative leadership skills, with the ability to challenge assumptions, guide executive-level discussions, build alignment, and influence decisions across complex stakeholder groups.

jobs.description:
Job Type

Full-time

Description

JOB SUMMARY

Provide Program Management, Engineering, and C-130 Maintenance expertise to assist in the sustainment of the C-130 Combined Total Force test organization at Little Rock AFB, AR. Support may require, working with the host unit for aircraft, operational, maintenance manpower, and equipment support. Support requirements also include drafting and coordinating memorandums of understanding (MOUs) and memorandums of agreement (MOAs) for parking, aircraft ground equipment, use of government-owned vehicles, building management responsibilities, and airspace correspondence.

Roles And Responsibilities

Responsible for the day-to-day program management activities. Includes, but not limited to, keeping all programs on cost and schedule, communicating with customers to ensure their satisfaction, soliciting feedback, travel for various programmatic meetings, etc.
Manage and maintain customer relationships; communicate their needs to senior management; oversee customer meetings.
Provide a quarterly Program Management Review (PMR) for each program under contract within business area and present same to Headquarters staff.
Develop methods to monitor progress and provide corrective supervision if necessary.
Resolve and assist in the resolution of conflicts within and between GMRE employees/contractors.
Present oral and written reports defining plans, problems, and resolutions to appropriate levels of management.
Monitor and maintain program schedule to include actual hours worked for any persons working on assigned program(s).
Plans for technical support functions required to support engineering.
Research, and development projects and activities.
Functions may include set-up, maintenance, circuit testing, assembly, installation, and fabrication.
Independently evaluates, selects, and applies standardized principles and procedures in area of specialization to problems and projects of moderate complexity.
Diagnoses and corrects complex system and equipment problems.
Develops and conducts testing activities.
May participate in design modifications in the completion of moderately complex assignments.
May guide the technical efforts of less experienced staff.
Serve as maintenance liaisons between AATC and tenant units to include GSU’s and TDY locations for all maintenance related requirements.
Support requirements also include drafting and coordinating memorandums of understanding (MOUs) and memorandums of agreement (MOAs) for parking, aircraft ground equipment, use of government owned vehicles, building, management, responsibilities, and airspace correspondence.
Complete 272 and 273 paperwork for SPO submittal and track all modifications for Configuration Management. Maintain all modification paperwork and provide input on new Technical Order procedures as a result of the modification.
Ensure the accurate and timely completion of all paperwork, CDRLs, and reports to assigned program(s)
Responsible for having knowledge of the Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR), USC, and Code of Federal Regulations (CFR).
Responsible for adhering to company Policies and Processes.
Submit MSR’s (Monthly Status Reports) to GMRE headquarters by the 5th day of every month. The MSR will include employee’s name, supported MDS, a maximum of 5 bullet points for significant events for the month, travel for the past month and any significant events and activities for the next 60 days.
Support the AATC Commander as needed on various ancillary projects.

WHY WORK FOR GMRE?

GMRE is a small veteran-owned company who cares about our employees. We offer health, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k), vacation, Paid Time Off (PTO), or Paid Sick Leave (PSL) based on state laws, paid holidays, and life insurance to all permanent full-time employees. GMRE’s mission is to provide high quality engineering and technical services to help our customers grow and succeed.

GMRE is an equal opportunity employer. GMRE is committed to making employment decisions based on valid requirements, without regard to age 40 and over, color, disability, gender identity, genetic information, military or veteran status, national origin, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation or any other applicable status protected by state or local laws.

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice.

Requirements

REQUIRED SKILLS/ABILITIES

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills.
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
Excellent time management skills with a proven ability to meet deadlines.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Strong supervisory and leadership skills.
Ability to prioritize tasks and to delegate them when appropriate.
Ability to function well in a high-paced and at times stressful environment.
Ability to maintain regular attendance and punctuality.
Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite or related software.
Ability to work flexible hours and be available to respond on short notice as needed.
Ability to maintain professional appearance.

Education And Experience

Bachelor’s degree, with 15 years DoD experience.
Excellent analytical and time-management skills.
Strict adherence to company guidelines, compliance laws, and legal requirements.
Good interpersonal skills and communication with all levels of management.
Solid verbal and written communications skills.
Able to multitask, prioritize, and manage time efficiently.

Security Clearance And Other Requirements

You are required to obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance. Failure to obtain and maintain the required level of clearance may result in the withdrawal of a job offer or removal.
Driving or renting a car for company business is expected with some frequency. For insurance purposes, a valid driver’s license is required.
Ability to pass a background check to be granted access to the specific working location installation bases to perform work for GMRE.

Supervisory Responsibilities

Oversees the daily workflow of the C-130 Little Rock CTF.
Provides constructive and timely performance evaluations.
Handles discipline and termination of employees in accordance with company policy.

Physical Requirements

The work is generally sedentary, there will be some recurring periods of maintaining equipment which may require employee to lift equipment, stand, walk, stretch, bend, reach, and stoop for short periods of time, requiring only moderate physical ability and physical stress.
Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds at times.

Travel Required

This position may require travel up to 50% of the time from normal duty station to CONUS and OCONUS locations and may include remote or isolated sites. You must be able to travel on military and commercial aircraft for extended periods of time to fulfill contract requirements.

.

The Common Hardware Group (CHG) creates innovative hardware platforms central to the AI era, powering Cisco’s core Switching, Routing, and Wireless products for organizations globally. Our innovations in silicon, optics, and hardware platforms—like Silicon One—are shaping the technology industry. We're a global team of creative experts, bringing our unique backgrounds and bold ideas to push boundaries and help each other grow. Because full product development—from design to qualification to production—is within our team, we’re able to think differently, experiment more, and work quickly. Join us to power the future of the digital world.

Your Impact

Responsibilities

In this role, you will lead complex, multi-functional programs that span silicon development, firmware, and system delivery — driving execution from initial concept through production. You’ll collaborate with diverse engineering teams, operations, and vendors to deliver high-quality solutions while shaping processes and ensuring strategic alignment across the organization. Specific Responsibilities include:

Lead multi-functional infrastructure and ASIC development projects from concept through production, coordinating efforts across Silicon Engineering, Platform, Software, Hardware Systems, Sourcing, Operations, and external vendors.
Manage all phases of ASIC development including design, verification, validation, qualification, and production release, ensuring seamless execution and delivery.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align technical requirements, architectural constraints, and product management goals delivering ASIC solutions and high-quality system products.
Identify and implement process improvements across teams and functions to enhance efficiency and delivery in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer or Electrical Engineering or other technical field and an equivalent experience of 12+ years in the industry.
Experience in Program/Product management or Technical/Engineering management with proven leadership in delivering successful products.
Experience leading or managing ASIC development programs, with a demonstrated knowledge of the end-to-end silicon lifecycle.
Experience driving complex, cross-functional projects that span multiple engineering disciplines, such as silicon, hardware systems, software, and operations.
Strong program management skills, including milestone planning, risk management, dependency tracking, and delivery execution.

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree in Computer Science and/or Electrical Engineering or other technical field.
Prior experience in managing ASIC design flow (architecture, micro-architecture, RTL, Synthesis, functional verification, physical layout etc.)
Experience in pre-silicon testing with Emulation, FPGA, and post-silicon validation.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

U.S. employees are offered benefits, subject to Cisco’s plan eligibility rules, which include medical, dental and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with a Cisco matching contribution, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability coverage, and basic life insurance. Please see the Cisco careers site to discover more benefits and perks. Employees may be eligible to receive grants of Cisco restricted stock units, which vest following continued employment with Cisco for defined periods of time.

U.S. employees are eligible for paid time away as described below, subject to Cisco’s policies:

jobs.description:
Role Description

Technical Program Manager

Project Manager II

Who We Are

Born digital, UST transforms lives through the power of technology. We walk alongside our clients and partners, embedding innovation and agility into everything they do. We help them create transformative experiences and human-centered solutions for a better world.

UST is a mission-driven group of 29,000+ practical problem solvers and creative thinkers in more than 30 countries. Our entrepreneurial teams are empowered to innovate, act nimbly, and create a lasting and sustainable impact for our clients, their customers, and the communities in which we live.

With us, you’ll create a boundless impact that transforms your career—and the lives of people across the world.

Visit us at UST.com.

You Are

UST is seeking an experienced Technical Program Manager (TPM) with strong software development program experience to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives across engineering, product, QA, DevOps, and client stakeholders.

The Opportunity

Lead and execute cross-functional software development programs spanning engineering, product management, QA, DevOps, and operations teams.
Own program schedules, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks, and executive-level reporting.
Translate business and product requirements into clear technical execution plans.
Drive program execution across the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)—design, development, testing, deployment, and support.
Coordinate delivery across backend services, APIs, microservices, data platforms, and cloud-based systems.
Facilitate Agile program-level ceremonies including PI planning, release planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
Identify and proactively mitigate technical, execution, and dependency risks.
Manage cross-team and cross-geo dependencies to ensure alignment and accountability.
Track and communicate program health using metrics related to schedule, quality, scope, and resource utilization.
Support client interactions, executive reviews, and stakeholder communications.
Drive change management, scope trade-offs, and prioritization decisions to meet delivery commitments.
Partner with engineering leadership to align on architecture, design decisions, and technical dependencies.

This position description identifies the responsibilities and tasks typically associated with the performance of the position. Other relevant essential functions may be required.

What You Need

8+ years of experience managing software development programs or technical project delivery.
Strong understanding of software architecture, distributed systems, APIs, and cloud-based applications.
Hands-on experience managing programs involving:
Backend systems and microservices
Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
Enterprise or large-scale software applications
Deep understanding of Agile / Scrum / SAFe methodologies.
Proven ability to manage cross-functional and client-facing programs.
Strong program management, execution discipline, and stakeholder communication skills.
Ability to drive risk management, technical triage, and data-driven decision-making.
Desired Skills:
Prior experience as a Software Engineer, Technical Lead, or Architect.
Exposure to DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, release management, and production operations.
Experience working in client delivery or matrixed environments.
Familiarity with JIRA, Confluence, MS Project, Smartsheet, or similar tools.
PMP, PgMP, SAFe, or Agile certifications (preferred but optional).
Qualification:
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
Equivalent industry experience will also be considered.

Compensation can differ depending on factors including but not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, education, and level of experience. UST provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles that may be hired in various U.S. markets as set forth below.

Role Location: Redmond, Washington

Compensation Range
:
$102,000-$153,000

Benefits

Full-time, regular employees accrue a minimum of 10 days of paid vacation per year, receive 6 days of paid sick leave each year (pro-rated for new hires throughout the year), 10 paid holidays, and are eligible for paid bereavement leave and jury duty. They are eligible to participate in the Company’s 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer matching. They and their dependents residing in the US are eligible for medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as the following Company-paid Employee Only benefits: basic life insurance, accidental death and disability insurance, and short- and long-term disability benefits. Regular employees may purchase additional voluntary short-term disability benefits, and participate in a Health Savings Account (HSA) as well as a Flexible Spending Account (FSA) for healthcare, dependent child care, and/or commuting expenses as allowable under IRS guidelines. Benefits offerings vary in Puerto Rico.

Part-time employees receive 6 days of paid sick leave each year (pro-rated for new hires throughout the year) and are eligible to participate in the Company’s 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer matching.

Full-time temporary employees receive 6 days of paid sick leave each year (pro-rated for new hires throughout the year) and are eligible to participate in the Company’s 401(k) program with employer matching. They and their dependents residing in the US are eligible for medical, dental, and vision insurance.

Part-time temporary employees receive 6 days of paid sick leave each year (pro-rated for new hires throughout the year).

All US employees who work in a state or locality with more generous paid sick leave benefits than specified here will receive the benefit of those sick leave laws.

What We Believe

We proudly embrace the values that have shaped UST since day one. We build our culture of Humility, Humanity, and Integrity. These values inspire us to nurture a people-first, human centric culture that fosters diversity, prioritizes sustainable solutions, and keeps our people and clients at the forefront of all decisions.

Humility

We will listen, learn, be empathetic and help selflessly in our interactions with everyone.

Humanity

Through business, we will better the lives of those less fortunate than ourselves.

Integrity

We honor our commitments and act with responsibility in all our relationships.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

UST is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law. We will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with state and local laws and “fair chance” ordinances.

UST reserves the right to periodically redefine your roles and responsibilities based on the requirements of the organization and/or your performance.

jobs.description:
Job Description – Technical Project Manager

RPA & Agentic AI Projects

Company: Catnip Infotech Pvt. Ltd.
Location: Chennai
Employment Type: Full-time
Experience: 7–12 years
Reporting To: Delivery Head / Practice Head

Role Overview

Catnip Infotech is looking for an experienced Technical Project Manager to lead enterprise-level Robotic Process Automation (RPA), Artificial Intelligence, and Agentic AI implementation projects.

The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end project delivery, including requirements assessment, solution planning, technical coordination, customer communication, resource management, risk management, governance, and successful production deployment.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage the complete lifecycle of RPA and Agentic AI projects—from discovery and solution design through development, testing, deployment and support.
* Conduct process-discovery workshops with customers and identify automation and AI opportunities.
* Translate business requirements into functional requirements, technical specifications, user stories and project plans.
* Work closely with RPA developers, AI engineers, solution architects, business analysts, infrastructure teams and customer stakeholders.
* Prepare project scope, effort estimates, timelines, resource plans, milestones and delivery schedules.
* Manage multiple projects and project teams simultaneously.
* Lead RPA implementations using platforms such as IBM RPA, UiPath, Automation Anywhere or Microsoft Power Automate.
* Coordinate the development and deployment of Agentic AI solutions involving AI agents, LLMs, APIs, enterprise applications, databases and knowledge repositories.
* Understand agent orchestration, prompt workflows, human-in-the-loop processes, tool calling, RAG and enterprise AI integrations.
* Ensure secure integration with systems such as SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, HRMS, CRM, ERP, email, document management platforms and customer portals.
* Coordinate infrastructure, cloud, on-premises, cybersecurity and access-related requirements.
* Track project progress, dependencies, issues, risks, change requests and mitigation actions.
* Conduct daily or weekly project reviews and provide accurate status reports to customers and internal management.
* Maintain project documentation, including project plans, MOMs, RAID logs, change-control records, test reports and acceptance documents.
* Establish delivery governance, quality controls and escalation mechanisms.
* Ensure adherence to coding standards, security requirements, data privacy policies and responsible-AI principles.
* Plan and coordinate SIT, UAT, performance testing, production deployment and hypercare support.
* Monitor automation success rates, AI response quality, accuracy, adoption and business benefits after deployment.
* Manage customer expectations and maintain strong relationships with business and technology stakeholders.
* Support presales activities by contributing to solution proposals, effort estimations, demonstrations, SOWs and technical presentations.
* Mentor team members and encourage timely, high-quality and accountable project delivery.

jobs.title: Engineering Program Manager, Devices
jobs.description:
About Atomic Machines:

Atomic Machines is ushering in a new era of micromanufacturing with its Matter Compiler™ technology platform. This platform enables new classes of micromachines to be designed and built by providing manufacturing processes and a materials library that are inaccessible to semiconductor manufacturing methods. It unlocks MEMS manufacturing not only for device classes that could never be produced by semiconductor methods, but also for entirely new categories. Furthermore, this digital platform is fully programmable in the way 3D printing is digital, but whereas 3D printing produces parts of a single material using a single process, the Matter Compiler™ technology platform is a multi-process, multi-material system: bits and raw materials go in, and complete, functional micromachines come out. The Atomic Machines team has also created an exciting first device, made possible only through the Matter Compiler™ technology platform, addressing a critical need in the rapidly evolving AI data center world, and we are commercializing it now.

Our offices are in Emeryville and Santa Clara, California.

About The Role:

We are seeking a highly technical Engineering Program Manager to own the program for that first device's successor, end to end: from requirements still maturing with lead customers, through qualification, certification, and manufacturing scale-up on the Matter Compiler, to commercial launch. That successor is a new class of micromachine, made possible only by the Matter Compiler, and you will be the leader that delivers it.

At Atomic Machines, Program Management is a leverage function, and its core skill is clarity. The Device program's technical leadership is already in place: device design, process, test, and reliability are each led by deep domain owners who move fast and expect the same. You lead that team as one program, and you drive the outcome, integrated plan, customer commitments, tradeoffs, operating cadence, and decisions that keep every discipline moving as one. Technical direction belongs to the domain owners; turning their work into the outcomes of certified, scaling, revenue-generating products belongs to you. This role is for someone who was an individual contributor in complex technical domains and moved into program leadership on purpose: to influence product direction, align engineering and manufacturing, and own outcomes end to end.

What You'll Do:

Develop and drive the program roadmap end to end: set goals, define milestones and evidence gates, and build the accountability structure that connects daily engineering work to business outcomes and customer commitments.
Direct cross-functional execution across device physics, fabrication processes, automation, and system integration: set the deliverables, sequencing, and resource calls for engineering, operations, and leadership.
Build and run the integrated plan connecting customer commitments, design maturity, process capability, and manufacturing readiness. Run the operating cadence that keeps it honest.
Turn maturing customer requirements into committed, testable targets, and hold the program to them.
Build the program structures that keep device and process development in lockstep with the Matter Compiler platform. Move development from R&D into production and define what each handoff must prove.
Structure the program around evidence and short learning loops: design the build-test-learn iteration cycles, give every open unknown an experiment with a pass/fail criterion, and let the schedule follow from results.
Own the qualification and certification path (e.g., UL/IEC) as a program commitment shaped into the design from day one.
Deliver the outcome: the device demonstrated, evaluated by lead customers, and qualified through production ramp.
Institutionalize what you learn: build the systems, rhythms, and decision structures the whole organization runs on, so the next program moves faster than this one.

What You'll Need:

8+ years spanning hands-on engineering and technical program leadership on complex multidisciplinary hardware: you have personally taken things from thought to build and owned programs that others depended on.
A track record of taking integrated hardware systems from concept through manufacturing release and commercial delivery, with the judgment to know when a decision needs more rigor and when to move fast.
Deep technical fluency in at least one core engineering domain and productive command across the rest: you hold your own with engineers designing in coupled physical domains — electromagnetics, structural mechanics, thermal behavior, fluidics, and materials.
You drive senior technical leads to deliver at a high level: clarity, structure, and pace, while technical direction stays with the domain owner.
Relentlessness in driving through ambiguity: turning unresolved requirements into scope, evidence gates, and a plan the team runs.
Conviction in iterative hardware development and short learning loops — build early, test early, learn fast, continually finding the shortest learning loop.
True Ownership of your program and domain, with bottom-line-up-front communication, trusted by engineers and leadership alike. The strongest people you've worked with would choose to work with you again.
BS or higher in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Materials Science.

Nice to Have:

Reliability engineering for microscale or precision devices: accelerated life testing, environmental stress testing, and long-term performance characterization.
Experience driving a product through UL, IEC, or equivalent certification.
Experience standing up programs from ground zero, then driving reliability growth to manufacturing scale.

Job Description

We are Lennar

Lennar is one of the nation's leading homebuilders, dedicated to making an impact and creating an extraordinary experience for their Homeowners, Communities, and Associates by building quality homes and providing exceptional customer service, giving back to the communities in which we work and live in, and fostering a culture of opportunity and growth for our Associates throughout their career. Lennar has been recognized as a Fortune 500® company and consistently ranked among the top homebuilders in the United States.

A Career that Empowers You to Build Your Future

Lennar is seeking a Senior Delivery Manager accountable for delivery across the full HR Technology portfolio — Workday, ServiceNow HR Service Delivery, Employee Center Pro, NowMobile, Docebo, Paradox, and custom HR applications.

This is a player-coach role with no direct reports. The Senior Delivery Manager sets the delivery cadence, sequences the roadmap, owns release and change management, holds vendors to their commitments, and gets into the details when a release, cycle, or escalation requires it. Influence and follow-through are the currency of the position.

Key Responsibilities

Portfolio Accountability

Own end-to-end delivery accountability for the HR Technology portfolio across Workday (Core HCM, Security, Compensation, Recruiting, Talent, Absence, Time, Payroll, Reporting), ServiceNow HRSD and Employee Center Pro, NowMobile, Docebo, Paradox, and custom applications.
Build and maintain an integrated roadmap that sequences projects, module deployments, and vendor releases against realistic capacity.
Own demand intake and prioritization, including business case validation, effort sizing, trade-off analysis, and transparent disposition of requests.
Partner with HR, Total Rewards, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Finance, Legal, and IT leaders to translate objectives into a funded delivery plan.
Manage portfolio financials — budget planning, forecast tracking, software and services spend, and variance explanation.

Release & Change Management

Own the HR Technology release calendar across all platforms, including Workday's two annual releases and weekly service updates, ServiceNow upgrades, and vendor-driven cycles.
Run the release lifecycle: feature assessment, impact analysis, adoption decisions, regression testing, sign-off, deployment, and post-release validation.
Set and enforce change control standards — environment strategy, tenant refresh cadence, configuration migration, approval gates, and rollback plans.
Chair release readiness and go/no-go reviews, and make the call when readiness criteria are not met.
Coordinate cross-platform dependencies so changes in one system do not break integrations, service workflows, or reporting in another.
Own release communication and enablement, including business-facing release notes, training updates, and support readiness.

Delivery Leadership

Set and sustain the team's delivery cadence — intake, planning, iteration reviews, release checkpoints, and retrospectives.
Provide direction, prioritization, and technical challenge to analysts and engineers without formal reporting authority; unblock work and escalate decisively.
Mentor the team on requirements quality, testing rigor, and documentation standards, improving delivery predictability and defect escape rates over time.
Step into hands-on work as needed — writing requirements, reviewing design and configuration, leading escalated troubleshooting, and supporting critical cycles.

Vendor & Service Management

Manage HR Technology vendors and implementation, AMS, and managed-service partners — scope, SOWs, deliverable quality, escalation, and service levels.
Direct partner and contractor resources with accountability for outcomes rather than activity; support renewals, license true-ups, and vendor roadmap reviews with Procurement, Legal, and IT.
Own the support model for the portfolio, including triage standards, service levels, and incident and problem management.
Ensure the portfolio meets security, privacy, audit, and compliance requirements, including access governance and SOX-relevant controls.

Measurement & Governance

Define and report portfolio health metrics — delivery predictability, release quality, incident volume and aging, adoption, and value realized.
Deliver executive updates and decision briefs that are concise, honest about risk, and actionable.
Operate an HR Technology governance forum aligning HR, IT, and business stakeholders on priority and sequencing, and maintain the portfolio risk and issue register.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Business, HR, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
Ten or more years delivering enterprise technology, including at least five leading HR technology delivery, programs, or a product portfolio.
Demonstrated accountability for a multi-platform HR technology portfolio, with substantive hands-on Workday experience plus at least one other enterprise HR platform.
Proven ownership of formal release and change management for enterprise SaaS — release calendars, regression testing, environment strategy, and go/no-go authority.
Track record leading delivery teams and cross-functional workstreams without formal reporting authority.
Vendor and systems integrator management experience, including scope, SOWs, performance accountability, and escalation.
Functional fluency across core HR, compensation, talent acquisition, learning, absence, time, payroll, and HR service delivery.
Sufficient technical depth to interrogate design decisions and judge whether a solution will hold up in production.
Executive-level communication, candor about risk, and absolute discretion handling confidential data

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on experience with ServiceNow HRSD, Employee Center Pro, and NowMobile.
Experience with Docebo or comparable learning platforms and with conversational AI recruiting tools such as Paradox.
Workday Pro, ServiceNow, or equivalent platform certifications; PMP, SAFe, Scrum, or ITIL credentials applied pragmatically.
Experience owning delivery for custom-built HR applications alongside packaged SaaS.
Large multi-brand or multi-entity enterprise experience (5,000+ employees), including acquisition integration.
Exposure to SOX or similar control environments as applied to HR and payroll systems.
Homebuilding, construction, real estate, or financial services experience.

Physical & Office/Site Presence Requirements:

Location will be Miami, FL (Lennar Corporate Headquarters) or Remote (U.S.)

This is primarily a sedentary office position which requires the incumbent to have the ability to operate computer equipment, speak, hear, bend, stoop, reach, lift, and move and carry up to 25 lbs. Finger dexterity is necessary.

Direct employment

jobs.description:
Position Overview

As a Senior Project Manager, you will lead delivery across multiple workstreams for large, complex enterprise clients. You will oversee sprint execution in Azure DevOps, guide planning and project working sessions, and ensure alignment across business stakeholders and Endeavor4’s functional and technical teams. The role includes managing enhancements, integrations, reporting, and day-to-day issue resolution within a complex Dynamics 365 CE and F&SC ecosystems.

This role works closely with Business Analysts, Developers, QA Analysts, Architects, and client leadership to ensure requirements are well defined, timelines are achievable, risks are addressed proactively, and deliverables remain on track. The Project Manager must be comfortable operating in an Agile environment and coordinating day-to-day work across teams to support enterprise-scale delivery.

A strong candidate will be able to lead discussions with business and IT leadership, communicate clearly across teams, and manage competing priorities across parallel workstreams.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

The Senior Project Manager (PM) is responsible for planning and coordinating enhancements, integrations, application changes, and operational improvements across clients’ D365 platform, including all supporting applications, data solutions, and reports. This includes sprint execution, release management, stakeholder communication, risk management, and enforcing Endeavor4’s delivery standards across all project workstreams.

Responsibilities Include

Azure DevOps & Delivery Management

Maintaining all project work items in Azure DevOps, including Epics, Features, User Stories, Tasks, Bugs, and sprint backlogs, to ensure accurate tracking and alignment with client delivery standards.
Leading all Agile ceremonies including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews/demos, and retrospectives.
Ensuring user stories, acceptance criteria, and tasks are clearly defined, properly documented, and fully traceable throughout delivery.
Monitoring project progress against planned scope and milestones.
Maintaining visibility into dependencies across functional, technical, and QA workstreams, while coordinating issue resolution as needed.
Tracking issues, risks, and blockers in Azure DevOps and driving timely resolution or escalation as needed.

Stakeholder Management & Communication

Leading work sessions with business and technical stakeholders to review progress, align on priorities, resolve blockers, and ensure cross-team clarity on scope and next steps.
Preparing and leading monthly executive-level updates (e.g., steering committee meetings), including roadmap reviews, delivery summaries, risk escalations, and recommendations for business and IT leadership.
Communicating status, scope changes, risks, and key decisions to client executives, SMEs, and project sponsors in a proactive and timely manner.
Facilitating decision-making discussions across client teams and ensuring alignment on priorities and expectations.

Project Planning & Governance

Creating project plans, timelines, communication plans, and resource forecasts to support delivery.
Managing scope and enforcing change control processes to ensure alignment with agreed-upon objectives.
Coordinating cross-system integration and dependency work across Azure services, on-premise applications, reporting systems, and financial applications.
Ensuring that requirements, design, development, testing, and deployment follow a consistent documentation and delivery process.
Supporting QA and UAT planning, including test script creation, defect management, and remediation cycles.
Leading release planning, deployment coordination, and post-deployment reviews to ensure successful production delivery.

Operational and Continuous Improvement

Identifying process gaps and recommending actionable improvements to enhance overall project execution.
Ensuring all documentation, backlogs, and project artifacts are accurately maintained and aligned with Endeavor4’s delivery standards.

EDUCATION

Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration, Finance or related field preferred.

Must Have Skills

7+ years of project management experience for enterprise application or integration projects.
Hands-on experience managing projects in Azure DevOps, including sprint planning, backlog management, boards, pipelines, and reporting.
Experience leading Agile ceremonies such as backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews/demos, and retrospectives.
Demonstrated experience running executive-level meetings (monthly status updates, quarterly reviews, roadmap discussions, etc.)
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present clearly to business leaders and technical teams.
Experience coordinating work across functional analysts, developers, QA testers, SMEs, and system architects to keep tasks aligned and moving forward.
Ability to manage dependencies across multiple systems.
High attention to detail and consistent follow-through.
Strong problem-solving and organizational skills, with the ability to bring clarity to complex or evolving situations.
Ability to manage day-to-day project activities independently, while coordinating with project leadership on priorities and direction.

Desired Skills And Experience

7+ years of implementing or supporting business systems and applications, preferably Microsoft Dynamics 365.
Experience working with finance/accounting systems.

Required Travel

Occasional travel to local and non-local clients.

Salary And Benefits

The compensation range for this position is $140,000 to $160,000 depending on years of comparable experience, skill set, and the unique value you bring. Company Description

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

AECOM
is seeking a Senior
Project Manager
to support our multi-disciplinary design team addressing the most challenging engineering tasks in power generation. AECOM's broad technical capabilities, global footprint and experience in executing large scale projects uniquely position us to lead in renewable, traditional steam, thermal power generation and advanced nuclear technologies.

This includes being a part of the first-of-a-kind program with AECOM partners advancing the innovative stellarator technology to the world.

https://aecom.com/press-releases/aecom-establishes-partnership-with-type-one-energy-to-provide-design-engineering-services-for-its-innovative-stellarator-fusion-power-plant-infinity-two/

For this role, AECOM offers the freedom and flexibility to work remotely and/or be located at a variety of Energy offices located in multiple locations across the United States.

We seek a project professional able to manage the project lifecycle from the project basis of design stage through the issuance of deliverables, ensuring seamless coordination between internal and external stakeholders.

This position requires a strong understanding of engineering design, interconnection, utility markets, and construction processes. The ideal candidate will possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills, as well as the ability to lead matrixed design teams and manage client-approved engineering consultants.

The successful candidate will:

Responsible for the management of assigned projects; Function as the project manager / program manager
Take ownership of internal project financials, staffing, legal coordination, and risk management.
Facilitate planning and kickoff meetings to ensure alignment among all project stakeholders.
Support projects through complete life cycle including the feasibility phase, preliminary and detailed design, issue-for-bid, construction, start-up, and commissioning
Facilitate the design process, including conducting "page-turn design reviews" and equipment fabrication reviews at key project milestones (30%, 60%, and 100% design completion).
Work closely with the technical delivery team (incl subcontractors) to confirm deliverables and services are being provided to exceed client’s satisfaction. This includes coordination with team members across the world
Deliver projects in accordance with the AECOM Quality Management System (QMS) process
Proposal support / capture leadership to support business development activities
Identify project opportunities early and facilitate go/no-go decisions, determine project fees, write proposals, prepare and lead client presentations, and negotiation of contracts
Client development through existing contracts/relationships including managing key accounts and developing new accounts
Occasional travel to client or project sites

Level specific responsibilities:

Responsible for the overall management administration to project and assists in establishing project specific objectives and policies.
Provides management and guidance to subordinate managers, enforces company and project policies, and a primary liaison between AECOM and client interface.
Oversees and ensures all facets of the project are delivered in accordance with design, budget and schedule through subordinate managers and supervisors.
Responsible for administering the project from budgeting/schedule stage through procurement and contract closeout. Position has significant profit/loss responsibility for assigned project.

AECOM’s Energy practice provides a wide range of services from consulting and engineering design to energy engineering, energy procurement and construction (EPC) for power, energy efficiency, and renewable energy clients. Our understanding of the big picture – and the interconnection between generation, distribution, storage, and the demand side of the meter – allows us to deliver holistic strategies that improve and modernize next generation energy infrastructure. We connect knowledge and experience across our global framework to bring together a unique combination of engineers, planners, scientists, and project managers who advance cleaner, secure, and more sustainable energy solutions.
