new_jobs.title: Digital Customer Success Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Full-time
Employee Type: Regular
Region: AMS - North America and Canada
Work Persona: Flexible or Remote

Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

The Digital Customer Success Program point person is responsible for designing and operating a scaled, digital-first customer engagement program within CS Operations that drives product adoption, customer health, and Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) for the Mid-Market segment.

This role owns the digital customer journey motions from onboarding through renewal—creating scalable plays and campaigns that deliver value at scale while intelligently routing accounts to human touch (CSM engagement) when signals indicate risk or expansion opportunity. You will partner closely with Mid-Market CSM Principals to shape program strategy, define segmentation and engagement rules, and ensure the digital program amplifies (not replaces) human-led relationships.

You are both strategist and operator: defining the program architecture, building the plays, running the daily operations, and translating customer signals into action.

Key Responsibilities

Drive Adoption

Design and execute lifecycle programs that accelerate onboarding, feature adoption, and time-to-value.
Create targeted engagement campaigns based on maturity and product usage.
Identify and recommend adoption improvements (in-product guidance, education, webinars, self-service resources) to Product and Marketing teams.

Protect Gross Revenue Retention

Develop automated interventions for at-risk customers.
Partner with CSMs to prioritize outreach and remediation efforts based on customer signals and business impact.
Measure and improve key indicators tied to renewal outcomes.

Digital Customer Programs

Own the digital customer journey from onboarding through renewal.
Create scalable programs that increase engagement without increasing headcount.
Leverage AI and automation to personalize customer experiences at scale.

Reasoning & Insights

Monitor adoption, engagement, and retention metrics.
Build dashboards and reporting for Executives and Customer Success teams.
Translate customer behavior data into actionable recommendations.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Partner with Product to improve adoption of strategic capabilities.
Work with Marketing on customer education and lifecycle communications.
Collaborate with CS Operations on tooling, data quality, and reporting.

Success Metrics

Gross Revenue Retention (GRR)
Renewal rate
Product adoption and feature utilization
Customer health score improvements
Shortened Time-to-value
Expansion-ready account creation
Digital engagement rates
Reduction in at-risk accounts
CSM capacity leverage

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

5-10 years in Customer Success, Customer Success Operations, Digital CS, Lifecycle Marketing, or Product Adoption roles.
Demonstrated success improving adoption and retention in a SaaS environment.
Previous experience building and launching a digital CS program
Strong reasoning skills with experience building health scores, segmentation, and customer journey programs.
Experience with customer success platforms, CRM systems, and marketing automation tools.
Comfortable operating as both strategist and builder.
Experience leveraging AI and automation to scale customer engagement.

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $116,400 - $192,100
, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs. Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location.

new_jobs.title: TECHNICAL PROGRAM MANAGER
new_jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Technical Program Manager (TPM) with 10+ years of experience managing complex technical programs within software development environments. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of software development methodologies and lifecycles, excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, and the ability to work effectively with engineering and cross-functional teams to drive programs from planning through successful delivery.

Roles and Responsibilities

Lead and manage complex technical programs and cross-functional initiatives from planning through delivery.
Define program objectives, scope, milestones, dependencies, and success criteria in collaboration with technical and business stakeholders.
Partner closely with Engineering, Product, Architecture, QA, and other cross-functional teams to ensure successful program execution.
Develop and maintain program plans, schedules, roadmaps, status reports, and risk registers.
Track program progress, identify risks, dependencies, and blockers, and drive timely resolution.
Facilitate cross-functional meetings and ensure clear communication of program priorities, decisions, and action items.
Apply a strong understanding of software development methodologies and SDLC processes to effectively manage technical initiatives.
Work closely with engineering teams to understand technical requirements, system dependencies, implementation challenges, and delivery timelines.
Use SQL and basic database/table structures to analyze data, investigate issues, and support data-driven program decisions.
Monitor key program metrics and provide regular status updates to leadership and stakeholders.
Manage project documentation, requirements, timelines, and workflows using tools such as Jira and Confluence.
Identify opportunities to improve program execution, delivery processes, and cross-functional collaboration.
Ensure programs remain aligned with organizational priorities, technical standards, and business objectives.

Required Qualifications & Experience

10+ years of experience in Technical Program Management, preferably within software development or technical program environments.
Strong understanding of software development methodologies and Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) processes.
Experience managing complex, cross-functional technical programs involving engineering teams.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Working knowledge of SQL and basic database/table structures.
Hands-on experience with Jira, Confluence, or similar project and program management tools.
Strong experience managing program schedules, dependencies, risks, issues, and stakeholder communication.
Excellent communication, organization, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams and influence outcomes without direct authority.

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on frontend or backend software engineering experience.
Technical background in software development, engineering, or architecture.
Experience managing large-scale software development programs.
Familiarity with Agile, Scrum, or other modern software development methodologies.
Experience working with distributed or cross-functional engineering teams.
